newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's CPI up 0.1 percent in April.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's CPI up 0.1 percent in April.

text.p: Tunisia's consumer price index (CPI) rose by 0.1 percent in April compared to March, official statistics showed on Friday.
It was up 0.9 percent in the first four months of 1997 compared to its level in December 1996.
The year on year index in April 1997 is put at 3.8 percent unchanged from its level in April 1996.
Inflation as measured by the CPI was 3.7 percent for the whole year 1996 from 6.3 percent in 1995. Official forecasts put it at below four per cent for the whole year 1997.
